The main takeaway from our work is that

the Cabonga nephel- ine syenite was emplaced at 1.17±0.03 Ga, and thus predated the onset of widespread and ubiquitous anorthosite-mange- rite-charnockite-mangerite-granite (AMCG) magmatism in western Quebec and Ontario.
